build_sgl_function: build an SGLang function by decorating a Python callable with the @function decorator to define a generation pipeline
create_gen_text: create a text generation node with sampling parameters like max_tokens, temperature, top_p, and stop conditions
create_select_choices: create a selection node that picks one choice from a list of string options using token-length normalized scoring
build_chat_roles: build chat message roles using system, user, and assistant functions that wrap expressions with role begin/end markers
run_runtime_backend: run an SGLang runtime backend by creating a Runtime instance that connects to the SGLang server endpoint
